provisional_fields.sample_rate_hz: Nominal interface placeholder only, not measured. This handshake-paced source pauses under backpressure and has no fixed physical sample period. Do not infer duration or DOA.

export_description.stream_error_scope: No errors observed by DMA status, length, sample ID, payload and guard checks for this acquisition. Not independent hardware error-counter qualification.
